title: A multiplicity-one oriented countably m-rectifiable set of locally finite H^m-measure defines an integer multiplicity current [[M]] with M_W([[M]]) ≤ H^m(M ∩ W) (Simon 6.2.2, 6.3.1, 6.3.2(3))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set that is countably m-rectifiable with H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and let η : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) be a.e.-strongly measurable for H^m⌞M such that for H^m-a.e. y ∈ M there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M y Q and η(y) a unit orientation of Q (IsUnitOrientationOf (η y) Q). Then there is an integer multiplicity current D ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (IsIntegerMultiplicity D) such that for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) the function y ↦ ⟨ω(y), η(y)⟩ = η(y)(ω(y)) is H^m⌞M-integrable and D(ω) = ∫_M η(y)(ω(y)) dH^m(y), and M_{W′}(D) ≤ H^m(M ∩ W′) for every set W′ ⊆ ℝ^P (H^m = μHE[m], M_{W′} = massOn).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable m M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable η (μHE[m].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[m].restrict M), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M y Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η y) Q) → ∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, IsIntegerMultiplicity D ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Integrable (fun y => η y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y)) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ D ω = ∫ y in M, η y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y) ∂μHE[m]) ∧ ∀ W' : Set (Euclid P), D.massOn W' ≤ μHE[m] (M ∩ W')
